Against an 8: several parts are held by reading or by calls the tests make themselves - the player's declaration window and the betrayal's confirmation (the tests call the declaration directly), the Dynamic proposal on its card (the notes: no test reads 'Proposed: {stat}'), a GM's own Take, the first-roll test's binding released by hand; the Shadow cover's signal that the GMs count a watcher the player may not see is the design today and its reach is not established; the opening's proposal on 'Ask again' is a known gap not re-read; seven of its tier-2 tests and scenario 89 were not in the base run's files read; all five live checks are unread, and the stage touches sockets, rolls and scenes.
stages.missing_to_10: LIVE-E68-01..05 read at a v14 table; the seven tier-2 tests and scenario 89 joined; a test that drives a player's declaration window and a Dynamic proposal card; the Shadow cover's watchers compared token by token between the primary and a player's page (or the signal accepted by the owner as a rule); R3200's stamp moved back to E68.

l1.what: The statistic proposal and Take from the Body at a table (LIVE-E68-01, -03 first; then -02, -04, -05)
recipe: As the killer's player in an Eclipse, declare a Direct Murder, pick Hand and write how; read the GMs' card (Allow: Hand, Change to: Body, Refuse, 'Proposed: Hand'); Allow; end the Eclipse with killer and victim alone; confirm the opening rolls Hand with no second window on the GM.
Repeat with Change to: Body, and with the card left unanswered until the lights.

With a body tile in a room: a student alone Takes two items (one Hand roll, no Shadow, no cards); then with a second student in the room (Hand, then Shadow against 16); force a miss with Hope and with Despair and read both cards in the witness's chat.
With the killer's accomplice in the room, record whether the Shadow is asked and who gets the miss card.
With a token the player's screen does not show in the room (if the table has one: a sneaking student, a veiled killer), Take and note whether a Shadow roll is asked.
l1.clients: GM and two players in separate browsers
l1.settles_if: Cards and buttons as listed, one roll window per road, the cover asked only with a visible witness: the stage holds; a second window, a cover asked with nobody visible, or a card in the wrong chat is a defect.

Whether the Shadow cover of a Take tells a player of a watcher their screen does not show (the 1.2.104 Known gap 252-254). Read: the taker's page counts movement.mjs othersInRoom (countsAsPresent: no Monokuma, no Spectator, no dead, no hidden token; a veiled killer counted, movement.mjs:3770) and the primary counts frisk.mjs roomWitnessesOnGm (body.mjs witnessesOf with monocubs: true, hidden excluded); handover.mjs:434 answers coverNeeded when the primary counts one and no cover came, and anonymity.mjs:559 then asks the Shadow roll. Not established: which tokens a player's per-browser hiding (visibility.mjs, the veil's mark, a sneaking student) keeps off the screen while both counts include them, and whether a Take is reachable in such a moment.

l1.what: Whether a Take's Shadow roll is asked with no witness on the taker's screen
recipe: Lay a body tile in a room.
Put a second student in the room whose token the taker's player cannot see (a veiled killer during an opening, or a sneaking student if the table has the road).
As the taker's player, Take one item; note whether a Shadow window opens.
Repeat with a Monocub in the room and with nobody.
l1.settles_if: No Shadow window with nobody visible: no signal; a Shadow window with nobody visible: the gap stands as a leak of presence (minor).
